caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic pitcher positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The pitcher is rendered in shades of dark gray and black, with highlights of white and lighter gray indicating reflections on its glossy surface. It features a cylindrical body with a flared rim and a distinct pouring spout at the top edge. Around its midsection and near the base, there are two sets of parallel decorative bands encircling the pitcher. The sturdy handle is attached to the upper and lower portions of the body, curving outward then looping back inward, displaying similar shading and highlight effects. The entire object is neatly contained within a softly outlined rectangular border, which is slightly offset from the edges of the paper, leaving ample margin space around the drawing. There are no additional objects, text, or background elements present within the composition.
title: Pewter Pitcher
